title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)

Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.

What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems

Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA SEGURANÇA DA INFORMAÇÃO
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra.

Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 160 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.

O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.

Objetivo:

Responsável pelo acompanhamento, controle e execução das atividades segurança da informação, disponibilizando ferramentas e auditando a utilização da mesma bem como assegurando, visando garantir a confidencialidade, integridade e disponibilidade dos sistemas e plataformas da empresa, dos parceiros e clientes, aumentando a eficiência operacional de forma segura, em conformidade com as normas e procedimentos da empresa. Criar filas de atendimentos e orientar o time a colocar o cliente no centro, priorizando o atendimento e a satisfação do cliente, sem deixar de seguir as regras de negócios e critérios de liberação de acesso. Auditar os acessos de administrador visando maior segurança e garantir a disponibilidade das ferramentas que liberam os acessos.

Atividades:

  • Coordenar equipe multidisciplinar para demandas de gestão de acesso e GRC SAP, atendimento de chamados e demandas de Segurança da Informação, sendo Blue e Red Team, garantindo o atendimento dentro dos prazos acordados, colocando o cliente no centro, priorizando a qualidade, agilidade e segurança nas liberações de acesso aos ambientes, ferramentas e sistemas do grupo.
  • Garantir a aplicação de princípios de segurança da informação, por meio da avaliação dos processos de tecnologia da informação.
  • Gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades, Firewall, IPS, Antivírus, EDR, AntiSpam, SIEM, WAF, Filtro de conteúdo Web, Cofre de Senha, HoneyPot, Threat Intelligence, Segurança em Nuvem, Forense, liberação de acesso para auditoria de Compliance e novas tecnologias.
  • Atuar na garantia da segurança de dados do ERP SAP e SAP HANA Cloud, validando a robustez do ambiente nativo e providenciando um ambiente protegido contra ameaças.
  • Conhecer arquitetura de centralização de repositórios de armazenamento, protegendo grandes quantidade de dados processados dos tipos estruturados, semiestruturados e desestruturados, Data Lake, para que seja possível prover segurança ao ambiente.
  • Proteger o ambiente tecnológico por meio do entendimento e aplicação de conceitos e metodologias de modelagem de ameaças cibernéticas.
  • Promover, sistematicamente, melhoria contínua, através da consolidação, monitoramento e análise dos indicadores de performance de segurança, bem como da elaboração de planos de ação, também é necessário criar indicadores de performance e monitoramento do ambiente.

Requisitos Mínimos:

  • Pós Graduação: Gestão de Segurança da Informação / Governança de TI / Gestão de Projetos / Sistemas de informação / Ciência da Computação
  • Conhecimentos e atuação nos conceitos/processos de segurança da informação:
  • OWASP, NIST, CIS, ISO27000;
  • Certificações desejáveis: Cobit, ITIL, ISFS – Information Seurity Foundation ou ISO 27001, PDPF – Privacy & Data Protection Foundation, AWS Security, Azure Security, CISSP, CISM;
  • Experiencia em gestão de projetos de segurança da informação;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de redes.

MODELO CLT - Híbrido 1x semana em Boituva/SP

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As a Collections Specialist, your mission is to execute recoveries hands-on while building the foundations of a scalable, fair, and data-driven collections function.

You will work directly on active cases — negotiating, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving — while also turning what you learn into clear playbooks, policies, and operating processes.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and design:

  • You recover capital today
  • You help ensure we recover it better, faster, and more predictably tomorrow

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in collections in Brazil .
  • Fluent in Portuguese and basic English.
  • Solid understanding of legal and judicial recovery frameworks .
  • Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and cohorts .
  • Ability to reason about effort vs. yield economics .
  • Working knowledge of SQL / BI tools (hands-on or close collaboration).
  • Highly execution-oriented — comfortable being in the weeds.
  • Structured thinker who turns chaos into process.
  • Clear, practical communicator with Ops, Risk, and Legal.
  • Ownership mindset — sees gaps and fills them.

Responsibilities

  • Execute collections hands-on across delinquency stages and products.
  • Manage negotiations and recoveries , including complex or sensitive cases.
  • Help design and maintain collections playbooks and policies .
  • Continuously improve case prioritization and escalation logic .
  • Partner with Data to translate execution insights into better segmentation and models.
  • Support and monitor external partners (law firms, agencies).
  • Track and communicate recovery performance and operational insights.
  • Act as a builder of the collections function , not just an operator.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Engenheiro (a) Agrícola PL

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro Agrícola Pleno para atuar no nosso time de Tratos Culturais.

Análise dos resultados da área, planejamento e programação das operações, acompanhamento orçamentário, organização e acompanhamento do controle agrícola.

Apoiar a gestão da rotina do setor, dimensionamento e acompanhamento de metas.

Acompanhamento das operações e das premissas técnicas.

Ensino Superior Completo em Agronomia.

Conhecimento em operações agrícolas na cana-de-açúcar.

Conhecimento em melhoria contínua.

Pacote Office avançado.

Residir em São José do Rio Preto, Tanabi ou Monte Aprazível.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!

About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.

About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.

Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.

Este/a profissional atuará em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, tendo estas atribuições principais:

  • Controlar interfaces com montagens industriais, garantindo que as estruturas civis, bases e alinhamentos estejam liberados dentro do prazo para instalação de equipamentos críticos;
  • Gerenciar o desenvolvimento e atualização do ‘’As Built” civil sincronizado com alterações de campo, revisões de engenharia e modificações industriais (MOCs);

  • Integrar a obra civil aos requisitos de segurança de processo, garantindo atendimento a normas, zoneamentos, distanciamentos, contenções, bacias e drenagem industrial;
  • Gerenciar a interface com fornecedores e contratados, alinhando soluções técnicas e cronogramas para minimizar impactos entre civil, montagem eletromecânica e comissionamento;
  • Atuar em parceria com a área de Suprimentos, dimensionando corretamente a compra de materiais, prezando por custo e boa gestão de estoques;
  • Manter relacionamento produtivo e transparente com entidades sindicais e órgãos fiscalizadores, conhecendo a legislação trabalhista e convenção coletiva, preservando a segurança empresarial.

Perfil Requerido:

title: Coordenador (a) de Manutenção Mecânica
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica ou Produção;
  • Experiência sólida em manutenção mecânica industrial;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos, pneumáticos, redutores, agitadores, bombas, motores, transportadores, caldeiras ou equipamentos industriais similares;
  • Conhecimento em sistema de gestão de manutenção SAP (PM);
  • Vivência em planejamento e controle da manutenção (PCM);
  • Experiência com gestão de equipes diretas e terceiras, incluindo análises de performance da equipe, avaliações de desempenho e feedbacks;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de manutenção (RCM, TPM, análise de falhas);
  • Conhecimento de indicadores de manutenção e ferramentas de melhoria contínua;
  • Noções de gestão de contratos e orçamentos;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em Araucária/PR, de segunda a sexta em horário administrativo, mas com disponibilidade para gerir equipe que trabalha em turnos.

Serão considerados como diferenciais:

  • Certificações em TPM, RCM ou confiabilidade;
  • Especialização em Manutenção ou Gestão Industrial;
  • Experiência profissional em empresas com processos industriais contínuos e de batelada, e segmento químico.

Atividades:

  • Coordenar o time de manutenção e garantir o planejamento das atividades de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva, pelas equipes diretas e terceiras, nos equipamentos mecânicos assegurando as análises e diagnósticos das falhas;
  • Participar no desenvolvimento de planos de manutenção mecânica preventiva e preditiva, contribuindo e codificando sistemas, conjuntos mecânicos e componentes;
  • Pesquisar no mercado novos produtos e desenvolver fornecedores de serviços de manutenção mecânica, realizando avaliação técnica e análise de custo x benefício x atendimento a requisitos legais;
  • Otimizar os processos de manutenção, por meio da definição de estratégias de estoque de peças e equipamentos sobressalentes, aplicando ações corretivas às anormalidades detectadas pelo setor produtivo e de manutenção preditiva e sensitiva (inspeções);
  • Contribuir no cumprimento de normas (NR12 e NR13), metodologias de testes, padrões e procedimentos técnicos e operacionais, contendo as especificações técnicas necessárias à execução e implantação dos projetos;
  • Planejar, programar e acompanhar tecnicamente as instalações de novas máquinas e equipamentos, para melhor adequação de layout e instalações, incluindo o acompanhamento e gestão de projetos de investimentos (CAPEX);
  • Garantir a implementação e aplicação das ferramentas de segurança preventivas e de controle junto as equipes de manutenção e das empresas terceiras sob sua gestão;
  • Controlar custos, avaliar e analisar a provisão de verba anual, assegurando a realização de reparos, reformas, substituição de peças, máquinas, equipamentos e circuitos painéis, conforme necessidade e programação.

title: Analista fiscal júnior

The position can be based anywhere in Latin America (Fully Remote).

About TVU Networks

TVU Networks is redefining how live content is created and distributed, from global broadcasters and sports leagues to the fastest-growing creator ecosystem.

As live streaming evolves from studios to the streets, from TV to creators, TVU provides the infrastructure powering reliable live video anywhere, trusted by major media organizations and top streamers worldwide.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role focused on developing partnerships with agencies, creators, production partners, and resellers, while driving revenue growth across hardware, connectivity, and self-served SaaS solutions.

Based in Latin America (fully remote), reporting to the VP of Content Creator Unit, you will act as the local engine of growth, helping partners succeed, unlocking new markets, reducing operational friction, and ensuring creators can adopt TVU seamlessly.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, partnerships, market development, and community building.

Who You Are

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on

  • Fluent Spanish and English (Portuguese a big plus)
  • Thrive in fast, ambiguous environments

Why This Role

  • Remote position anywhere in Latin America with high autonomy

title: Coordenador(a) de Suprimentos (Materiais e MRO).
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Desafio:

Coordenar o time de suprimentos Materiais, MRO, Insumos e Capex, definindo metas e indicadores, delegando responsabilidades, elaborando e aprovando planejamento e orçamento anual/mensal, garantindo a segurança das pessoas, otimizando recursos, custos e assegurando a eficiência dos serviços prestados.

Principais Atividades:

  • Coordenar e conduzir os processos de compras de MATERIAIS, MRO, INSUMOS E CAPEX suportando a melhoria de procedimentos e buscando aprovação da política de contratação de compras e importação de materiais, disseminando para as gerências clientes, assegurando a confiabilidade dos processos em linha com os objetivos e valores da Arauco;
  • Implementar, gerir e assegurar que as políticas e práticas de Suprimentos estejam alinhadas às práticas de mercado, para manter a atratividade e a captação de bons prestadores de serviços;
  • Coordenar o processo de negociação, contratação e construção do contrato de materiais, MRO, INSUMOS E CAPEX alinhado às políticas jurídicas e de compliance, assegurando as melhores práticas, intervindo nas negociações quando necessário, garantindo a compra com custos adequados, qualidade e a confiabilidade de todo o processo;
  • Coordenar o processo de construção de parcerias estratégicas de longo prazo com fornecedores, através da negociação de acordos de nível de serviço (SLAs), formalização e validação de contratos junto à área Jurídica, assegurando as melhores práticas e buscando iniciativas para mitigação de aumento de preços e otimização dos custos;
  • Garantir a participação de compras de materiais e Importações na Parada Geral, atuando no processo de planejamento, junto com a manutenção, desenvolvendo estratégias e plano de ação, para busca e captação de fornecedores, promovendo a negociação, sempre prezando pela segurança e otimização dos custos e a garantia de entrega de materiais
  • Administrar as demandas da Coordenação de Materiais e Importações, através de indicadores, Prazo médio de Pagamento, Custos, Saving, Lead Time, Prazo de Entregas, Devoluções, entre outros, intervindo nos processos, minimizando impactos às áreas demandantes, garantindo a satisfação dos clientes internos e otimizando os custos de todo o processo;

Experiência única, com atuação no viário dos acessos urbanos e integrações do empreendimento, em um ambiente portuário de alta complexidade, com participantes internacionais, em um time com tomada de decisão de alto nível.

title: Dealer Development Manager
description:
Job Description

Role Title: Dealer Network Development Manager

Experience Required: 5+ years of relevant experience

Role Purpose

To drive dealer network effectiveness, profitability, and readiness by ensuring process excellence, systems standardization, and continuous capability enhancement across all dealerships.

This role is pivotal in shaping the future of the dealer network by enforcing strong process discipline and enabling sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Dealer Network Development & Performance

  • Drive network planning and coverage expansion to ensure strategic presence across markets and maximize business potential.
  • Design and implement workshops aligned with Corporate Identity (CI) norms to optimize dealer infrastructure and service readiness.
  • Conduct periodic dealer performance reviews to evaluate business health, profitability, and customer experience outcomes.
  • Identify underperforming dealerships, recommend improvement plans, and oversee implementation through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strengthen dealer capability through structured engagement, capability-building, and performance enhancement programs.
  • Partner with field teams to ensure a uniform brand experience across all customer touchpoints, including sales and after-sales.

2. Systems, Processes & Operational Excellence

  • Establish and standardize systems, processes, and review mechanisms across dealerships and regions to ensure consistent operations and governance.
  • Implement and monitor business analytics and intelligence tools to enable data-driven decision-making and dealership profitability tracking.
  • Lead process improvement and re-engineering initiatives to enhance efficiency, responsiveness, and overall dealer–customer experience.
  • Identify and replicate Good Working Practices (GWPs) within the automotive industry to drive continuous improvement.
  • Conduct dealership audits to assess adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and recommend corrective actions to sustain compliance and performance.
  • Ensure organizational and dealer readiness for new or updated systems, digital tools, and operational frameworks.

Key Interfaces

Internal Stakeholders

  • Field Sales Teams
  • Service Teams
  • Finance
  • Legal

External Stakeholders

  • Dealership Owners
  • Dealership Management Teams

Impact & Contribution

  • Directly impacts dealer profitability, customer experience, and overall market performance.
  • Strengthens network capability through standardized processes, operational efficiency, and strategic coverage.
  • Acts as a key enabler in transforming the dealer ecosystem into a digitally capable, performance-driven, and customer-centric network.

title: Managing Director - Crypto Payment
description:
Location: Brazil (must currently reside in Brazil with valid Brazilian ID)

Language: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory), strong English preferred

Summary:

We are seeking an experienced, crypto-savvy Managing Director to lead and expand our crypto payment business in Brazil. The ideal candidate must be Brazil-based, with prior experience in crypto, deep knowledge of the local crypto/payment ecosystem, and strong relationships with key regulatory and industry stakeholders. This role is critical to supporting Brazil licensing efforts, including assisting with the DASP licence, and will work closely with the Brazil AMLO on regulatory matters.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the company in obtaining the DASP licence, collaborating closely with AMLO Brazil on all regulatory submissions and compliance preparations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) to support licensing and ongoing regulatory engagement.
  • Expand business development opportunities through a strong local network across crypto, payments, fintech, and financial institutions.
  • Lead Brazil's business strategy and drive growth for all crypto-payment products.
  • Maintain excellent relationships with crypto industry associations such as ABCripto, ABCB, and other relevant bodies.
  • Represent the company as the senior business leader in Brazil, attending industry events, regulatory meetings, and partnership discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (product, compliance, legal, operations) to ensure commercial success and regulatory alignment.

Requirements:

  • Must currently reside in Brazil with a valid Brazilian ID.
  • Prior experience in crypto is a must.
  • 10+ years’ experience in crypto payments, payment institutions, fintech, or related financial services.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto/payment regulatory environment, including BCB and CVM frameworks.
  • Proven track record and strong personal network with BCB, CVM, and major industry associations (ABCripto, ABCB).
  • Demonstrated ability to support licensing processes for payment or crypto-related entities in Brazil.
  • Strong business development experience, with a proven ability to grow partnerships and drive commercial expansion.
  • Fluent Portuguese; strong English preferred.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment.

Vision & Mission:

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Admissions Senior Data Analyst
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

THE OPPORTUNITY

Avenues São Paulo Avenues São Paulo is excited to announce an opportunity for a Data Analyst to join our Admissions, Enrollment, and Finance team. This critical role, reporting to Avenues São Paulo Finance, will support enrollment operations, processes, and analytics—transforming data into strategic insights that drive decision-making. As the owner of our enrollment database (from leads to post-event tracking and campaign performance), you will serve as the key liaison between Finance and Admissions. You will ensure that our data is accurately captured, clearly understood, and effectively reported. After completing enrollment data analyses, you will collaborate with various teams to translate insights into action across the organization.

ABOUT ADMISSIONS & FINANCE AT AVENUES

At Avenues São Paulo, the Admissions and Finance teams work in close partnership to ensure an exceptional experience for families and the long-term sustainability of our school.

The Admissions team is the first point of contact for prospective families, guiding and inspiring them as they learn about our unique global educational offering. With a high-touch, relationship-centered approach, Admissions provides a seamless and caring experience from inquiry to decision, ensuring each school year begins with a fully enrolled community of students who are an excellent match for Avenues and who bring diverse perspectives that enrich our campus.

The Finance team serves as a strategic partner to the school, stewarding resources responsibly to support Avenues’ long-term vision. Through ethical decision-making and comprehensive financial planning, Finance provides reliable, actionable data that informs key decisions, drives continuous improvement, and ensures the financial sustainability of the organization. The team is committed to delivering exceptional service to families and effectively managing the full financial cycle.

Together, Admissions and Finance work collaboratively to support families, strengthen operations, and uphold the mission and sustainability of Avenues São Paulo.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Data analysis, interpretation, forecasting. Track and interpret all key metrics pertaining to the São Paulo campus such as (but not limited to) applications received, processed, erosion, yield and attrition. Be prepared and informed to answer sophisticated, multi-data, high-judgment questions.
  • Marketing data & events performance/analysis. Complete dashboard on all event performances and KPIs generating feedback, including enquiries, leads and prospects tracking. Connect event performance to applications and other data ensuring intersection of admissions results to events.
  • Ensure that the databases are always functioning properly and are accurate
  • Contribute as a key team member to the implementation of a new CRM platform, possibly SalesForce.
  • Be the expert of all aspects of data, ensuring clear, accurate, and timely reporting.
  • Oversee the backend database for all new and re-enrollments.

Qualifications

ABOUT YOU

  • You care deeply about making operational processes work smoothly for your teams through data analysis
  • You're an intrapreneur who's always thinking about how to improve any system or process
  • You're a good listener who manages all your relationships with empathy and grace
  • You're highly tech-savvy, particularly with tools like CRMs, databases and Excel
  • You're incredibly organized and attentive to every detail
  • You love working with data, gleaning insights from it and helping others to understand it
  • You love collaborating closely with a variety of stakeholders and colleagues, and do so in both English and Portuguese
  • You can juggle multiple, shifting priorities and deliver on challenging deadlines
  • The Avenues mission energizes and inspires you

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Account Executive
description:
About UserGuiding

UserGuiding is a leader in the digital adoption field and has earned a 'Best Software' placement on G2 for two consecutive years. We work with globally recognized companies such as TOTVS, WEG, Caju, Wolters Kluwer, DigitalOcean, and Philip Morris International.

Role Objective

UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market, while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM.

You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.

Main Responsibilities

1. Full-Cycle Sales & Closing

  • Execute Inbound/Outbound: Manage inbound leads and signups from Brazil, the US, and LATAM. Perform high-impact discovery calls and tailored product demos.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and overcome objections to convert signups into long-term partners.
  • Cross-Regional Support: While focused on Brazil (Portuguese), you will leverage your time to handle inbound calls and outreach for the US (English) and other LATAM countries (Spanish).

2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach

  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on LinkedIn.

3. Strategy & CRM Excellence

  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.

Candidate Profile & Experience

  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.

Linguistic Versatility:

  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).
  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a "no-code" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.

Tech Stack

  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io
  • Comm: Google Meet, Slack.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.
  • Variable Bonus: Uncapped quarterly bonuses based on New Business Revenue (NBR) and pipeline targets.
  • Impact: A high-autonomy role where you directly influence UserGuiding's global expansion strategy.

title: Software Developer
description:
The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.5bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.

Purpose of Position:

Hexagon Mining develops intelligent collision avoidance systems for large vehicles used mainly in open-pit mining. Its products integrate satellite navigation, digital radio, multiple sensors and actuation systems as well as sophisticated algorithms to reliably predict dangerous scenarios and prevent accidents. It employs approx. 100 R&D staff in several attractive international locations. The software developer will join the team to develop this solution.

Major Areas of Responsibility:

  • Design, develop and support our server backend services and client tools used for the current and next generation of our collision avoidance and safety system.
  • Collaborate closely with the hardware, firmware, and backend service development teams to realize new integrated solutions.
  • Assist the product-introduction team and gain first-hand experience with our products.
  • Bring in innovative ideas for further development.

Knowledge and Experience - Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent;
  • Experience in C and C++ on embedded or Linux systems;
  • MQTT and other IoT related protocols, networking technologies in general, and related network security aspects;
  • Full professional English proficiency;
  • Team oriented and able to work independently;
  • Positive working attitude and good common sense to understand business requirements;
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally;

Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

  • Web technologies, React.js.
  • Knowledge of OpenWRT and Yocto
  • Knowledge of additional high-level language, e.g., Python, C#.
  • Development and/or maintenance of software for safety-critical, automotive, real-time or control systems
  • Development of localization, navigation, or perception systems based on technologies such as GNSS, radio, UWB, automotive radars, and IMUs.
  • Implementation of CAN, Ethernet, I2C, RS-232 or SPI-based drivers.
  • Functional Safety.
  • Experience with Test-Driven Design, Continuous Integration, and agile development processes (e.g., Scrum).

Travel:

  • 5-10%

Benefits:

  • Health plan
  • Comprehensive health program (psychological, nutritional, legal, financial, and social assistance)
  • Wellhub (Gym)
  • Life insurance
  • Meal/food allowance
  • Dental plan
  • Private pension plan

You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions like project management, product management, customer support and sales.

Join our team as a software developer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.

Hexagon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against any job applicant based on protected characteristics.

title: Innovation Procurement Coordinator
description:
ABOUT COTY

Coty is one of the world's largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. They celebrate and foster a culture of kindness and pride themselves on offering equal opportunities. Coty believes that beauty is found in diversity and is committed to creating an environment where every talent shines, valuing the unique contributions each individual brings to the team. As part of their commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome at Coty.

Join Coty and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to shaping the future of the beauty industry in Latin America through a unique footprint. Apply now to contribute your expertise and passion for technology and to drive digital transformation into our business success!

JOB OVERVIEW

As a Innovation Procurement Coordinator, you will be responsible for leading sourcing activities for NPD (New Product Development) initiatives across LATAM, ensuring cost competitiveness, supply continuity, and operational readiness for product launches.

You will act as the procurement focal point within cross-functional innovation teams, managing end-to-end sourcing strategy, supplier negotiations, risk mitigation, and alignment with global and regional category strategies.

This role requires strong project management capabilities, commercial acumen, stakeholder influence, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with R&D, Marketing, Initiative Management, Planning, and Manufacturing to understand upcoming innovation pipelines (2–3 year horizon) and translate them into sourcing strategies, material requirements, and execution roadmaps.
  • Lead end-to-end procurement activities for new peoduct development projects, from brief validation and supplier scouting to commercial negotiation, supplier nomination, and production handover.
  • Manage RFQs, cost breakdown analysis, supplier benchmarking, and negotiations aligned with Category Procurement strategy and financial targets.
  • Drive Design-to-Cost discussions with cross-functional teams, challenging specifications and proposing alternative materials, technical optimizations, and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Anticipate and mitigate supply risks, including tooling constraints, MOQ impacts, lead-time limitations, and supplier capacity risks.
  • Ensure pricing transparency, accurate forecasting inputs, and risk reporting prior to decision gates and launch approvals.
  • Track and report project savings, cost avoidance initiatives, and adherence to target cost objectives.
  • Act as escalation point for project-related supply disruptions until successful start of production (SOP).
  • Coordinate seamless transition from project phase to operational procurement and supply chain teams.
  • Influence stakeholders at managerial level, supporting data-driven decision-making and balancing commercial, technical, and timeline constraints.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • 4–7 years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, or Supply Chain, preferably within FMCG, beauty, pharma, or consumer goods industries.
  • Proven experience managing sourcing projects linked to product launches or innovation pipelines.
  • Strong negotiation skills with demonstrated cost management results.
  • Solid understanding of cost structures, supplier economics, and total cost of ownership (TCO).
  • Advanced project management capabilities (PMO knowledge required).
  • Advanced Excel skills (cost modeling, scenario analysis); strong PowerPoint storytelling skills.
  • Experience with SAP, Ariba, or SRM systems is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English required; Spanish is a plus.

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.

Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment

Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

If you’re hungry to learn, thrive in fast‑paced news, and want to grow quickly in a sector that never stands still, this is your moment.

The Role

We’re looking for a sharp, ambitious Reporter to join our newsroom and help shape our editorial voice across Europe and Brazil.

You’ll cover daily iGaming news, support senior journalists, and—crucially—develop original stories that go beyond recycled press releases. This is an ideal first step for someone building a journalism career and eager to develop deep industry expertise.

What You’ll Do

  • Write and publish accurate, timely news across regulation, M&A, product launches, and market trends
  • Review, edit, and publish press releases for our B2B News Support package
  • Maintain high editorial standards, sourcing, and attribution
  • Optimise headlines, metadata, and internal linking
  • Build a source tracker and grow toward original reporting, exclusives, and first‑hand stories
  • Produce 4–6 high‑quality stories per week , with a focus on originality, insight, and fresh angles
  • Help shape our brand voice and act as a strong editorial ambassador
  • Contribute to educating and expanding our presence in the Brazilian market

What You Bring

  • Journalism or editorial experience
  • Fluent Portuguese (essential)
  • Proven experience in the iGaming sector (essential)
  • Strong grammar, accuracy, and headline instincts
  • Ability to turn press releases into engaging B2B news
  • Organised, reliable, and deadline‑driven
  • Based in the UK

What Sets You Apart

  • Strong iGaming industry contacts and a passion for uncovering first‑hand stories
  • Curiosity, motivation, and the confidence to pursue stories even when they challenge industry narratives
  • SEO knowledge
  • Ambition to build sources and break stories

What’s In It for You

  • Ownership of our Press Release Support product
  • Fast progression toward explainers, features, and exclusives
  • A real opportunity to shape editorial identity and influence a fast‑growing brand

Benefits

  • Private health insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme & retail discounts
  • Flexible, remote‑friendly working

Why Join Us

You’ll be part of a fast‑growing, ambitious team where your work is seen, valued, and genuinely impactful. We champion curiosity, initiative, and growth — and we’ll support you in becoming a trusted voice in iGaming journalism, with a meaningful role in shaping how the industry is understood across Europe and Brazil.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Sr. Recruiter
description:
About the job

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute targeted hiring strategies to identify, and hire high-quality talent across sales, technical, and business roles.
  • Proactively source candidates using diverse channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support rapid hiring and future growth.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill needs, and success profiles.
  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador, ensuring candidates clearly understand the company’s mission, values, and employee experience.
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle—sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating assessments, and facilitating selection decisions.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).

description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Como tem experiência em ajudar muitas empresas de vários segmentos industriais, a APS3 trabalhará com você para garantir um sucesso semelhante para sua empresa .

O objetivo desse projeto é implantar um sistema robusto de gestão de pessoas que contemple trilhas de carreira, avaliação contínua de desempenho, Programas de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) e iniciativas estruturadas de engajamento e clima organizacional, assegurando o crescimento sustentável da empresa e a satisfação dos colaboradores.

description:
Who We Are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global leader in the delivery industry, on an ambitious mission to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery worldwide.

Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this purpose, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage.

With over 1,000 employees worldwide, Keeta is rapidly expanding — and you can be part of this journey.

We are looking for a strategic yet hands-on professional to lead the Internal Communications function in Brazil.

  • Experience in dynamic, fast-building environments (tech company background preferred);

title: Associate Teacher, Primary Division
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.

Language Immersion

Avenues students will graduate fluent in a second language and at ease beyond their borders. To this end, in grades N-1 students will be in a full English immersion program and from grades 2-5, Portuguese will take on a prominent place in the classroom.

As an Avenues Associate Teacher, you will:

  • Support lead teachers to develop and teach curriculum across multiple subjects that engages all learners in meaningful, challenging work that cultivates 21st-century skills
  • Help ensure that all students achieve key learning outcomes for the grade level, targeting instruction thoughtfully to address individual needs
  • Build a robust learning atmosphere that leads students to value being at school and feel part of a rigorous but joyful learning community
  • Collaborate intensively and daily with colleagues to continually improve student learning and school culture
  • Participate actively in ongoing, intensive professional learning

*Please note that this is a temporary position to cover a maternity leave.*

Qualifications

  • Student teaching, teacher training or equivalent experience with children ages 3-8
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Highly effective collaborator, eager to listen deeply, contribute to a team and achieve goals together
  • Very resourceful and adaptive, eager to embrace constant change, growth and learning
  • Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degree preferred

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Job Title: Senior Accountant

Responsibilities

1. Revenue Management

Billing or coordinate invoicing matters with customer, Prepare monthly revenue analytics and Monitor AR aging report, reconcile sales data with Tax output reports.

2. Cost Accounting & Analysis

Establish and improve the costing calculation system. Perform monthly closing activities related to cost of goods sold (COGS), ensuring accurate and timely product costing.

Conduct variance analysis (Purchase Price Variance, Material Usage Variance, Labor Efficiency Variance,

3. Fix assets, Inventory Management

Monitor all assets (e.g., inventory turnover, aging, obsolete inventory disposal), Oversee and execute periodic physical asset and inventory. Analyze discrepancies, propose and implement adjustment solutions to achieve alignment.

4. Report and Document Submission

Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow, Tax report and statistics preparation, ensuring the accuracy and timely declaration or submission to the local government department.

5. Support accounting-related processing for new business expansion.

6. Be responsible for the interpretation and application of the Accounting policy of HQ, annual audit.

Requirements

1. Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting is must, New factory establishment experience or CPA is a plus.

2.A minimum of 3 years in finance, costing, reporting experience in a manufacture environment .

3.Excellent knowledge of international trade.

4.Fluent in English language skills, both verbal and written, good at meeting deadlines and solving problems.

5.Proficient in MS Word and Excel, experience with ERP system.

6. Strong initiative and confident to handle complexity, work under pressure and manage short lead-time deliveries.

Shanghai Hi-road Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading integrated enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of premium bakery and catering ingredients. •Dairy and non-dairy toppings

Through continuous innovation and stringent quality standards, we strive to deliver exceptional value and culinary inspiration to our partners worldwide

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.

Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.

Job Description

Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.

Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.

Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.

Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.

Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

Em nossa trajetória de mais de 45 anos atuando em projetos de alta complexidade, o que nos move são os desafios de nossos clientes e a convicção de que podemos atuar diretamente na transformação de incertezas em oportunidades por meio da criação de soluções sob medida, qualificadas e inovadoras.
